definitions.explanation: A reading of 0° — most commonly 0°C (the freezing point of water), but also 0° in angle measurement. Often used in weather and scientific contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今朝|けさ}→今朝：02877_kesa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{気温|きおん}→気温：00235_kion⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{零度|れいど}だった。
examples.english: This morning's temperature was zero degrees.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今夜|こんや}→今夜：01411_konya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{零度|れいど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下回|したまわ}る→下回る：07649_shitamawaru⟧⟦{予想|よそう}→予想：03664_yosou⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{凍|こお}る→凍る：02100_kooru⟧⟦かもしれない→かもしれない：00164_kamoshirenai⟧。
examples.english: Tonight is forecast to drop below zero degrees, so the roads may freeze.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{零|れい}→零：00983_rei⟧ (zero) + ⟦{度|ど}→〜度：09845_do⟧ (degree). Default reference is Celsius; specify with ⟦{摂氏|せっし}→摂氏：12906_sesshi⟧{零度|れいど} or ⟦{華氏|かし}→華氏：28130_kashi⟧{零度|れいど} if needed.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {零度|れいど}⟦{以下|いか}→以下：01294_ika⟧: below zero
- {零度|れいど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下回|したまわ}る→下回る：07649_shitamawaru⟧: to drop below zero
- {零度|れいど}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{達|たっ}する→達する：02129_tassuru⟧: to reach zero degrees
- ⟦{氷点下|ひょうてんか}→氷点下：07669_hyoutenka⟧: sub-zero (literally 'below freezing point')

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {氷点|ひょうてん}: freezing point — refers to the point at which water freezes, often used in ⟦{氷点下|ひょうてんか}→氷点下：07669_hyoutenka⟧
- ⟦マイナス→マイナス：00268_mainasu⟧: minus / negative — ⟦マイナス→マイナス：00268_mainasu⟧{五度|ごど} = minus five degrees, very common in weather speech
